earned_statement: After the setting-independent h=1 preparation herald, any model assigning preexisting binary answers A0,A1,B0,B1 to each source state has pointwise CHSH magnitude two. Any setting-independent positive mixture of such tables therefore has CHSH at most two by convexity. The exact Audit-035 target has CHSH 1+3/sqrt(5)>2 and cannot arise from such a local answer-table census. Thus the remaining native receipt law must not reduce to preassigned local responses with positive setting-independent source weights.
